source_metadata.sampling_method: All returned records in the frozen official query, ordered by source start date, until pagination ends or declared maximum. Source availability/changes may affect coverage.
source_metadata.date_policy: Preserve exact/year/month source strings and ACTUAL/ESTIMATED types; no date imputation.
source_metadata.enrollment_policy: planned_enrollment uses only explicitly ESTIMATED enrollment; reported/current enrollment is not an original plan.
source_metadata.eligibility_feature_method: Lexical nonempty-line, Unicode-word and character counts from eligibility text; not counts of clinical conditions.
source_metadata.site_policy: Counts refer to locations/countries present in this current source projection; not planned sites or recruitment performance.
source_metadata.data_use: Public ClinicalTrials.gov registry records; cite the source and review its terms. No blanket third-party text license is asserted.
limitations: Current snapshots do not prove trial-start feature availability.
Completed-only drug-trial scope omits censored outcomes and does not represent all trials.
No patient-level data, original planned completion, treatment benefit or clinical validation is inferred.
First-registered date is not a timestamp for every current feature.
Counts are an acquisition inventory; training eligibility and temporal purging must be reported separately.
source_metadata.independent_evaluation: Independent ID-disjoint partial-start-date registry subgroup audit of development-selected phase refinement; not chronological or prospective validation.

warning: Retrospective research phase-consistency model. Current reported enrollment is not planned enrollment. Test schema slot identifies an ID-disjoint partial-start-date subgroup audit, not chronological/prospective validation. Original exact-date test was exposed and is not this branch's test. Class probabilities are uncalibrated; no clinical/regulatory phase assignment or success claim.

test.evaluation_role: ID-disjoint partial-start-date subgroup audit; not chronological

selection.rule: maximum tuning macro-F1 then balanced accuracy then declared grid order

test.evaluation_role: ID-disjoint partial-start-date subgroup audit; not chronological

selection.rule: Maximum tuning macro-F1 then balanced accuracy then model name; accuracy reported separately.

test.evaluation_role: ID-disjoint partial-start-date subgroup audit; not chronological

cohort.target: normalized single registry phase; original train/tuning plus frozen new partial-date audit

temporal_cutoffs.policy: Original exact-date training/tuning roles preserved. Test slot is fixed ID-disjoint partial-date subgroup; no chronological boundary or future-validation claim.

features.redaction: Existing explicit phase redaction plus NCT/date stripping and12000-character cap; canonical empty narrative slots required.

audit_protocol.purpose: Independent ID-disjoint partial-start-date registry subgroup audit of development-selected phase refinement; not chronological or prospective validation.
audit_protocol.eligibility: Pure phase label in canonical PHASE_LABELS; excluded from all original phase splits solely due to unavailable exact start-day precision (missing/invalid start date may also be listed). Historical union already excluded. All selected IDs remain unchanged and never enter fitting/tuning.
audit_protocol.selection: Refinement candidate chosen only on original tuning macro-F1 then balanced accuracy then accuracy then frozen model order; original phase_logistic comparator scored identically on this subgroup. No threshold, class regrouping, cohort trimming or model selection by audit scores.
audit_protocol.caveat: Different calendar-date reporting subgroup; may differ in era and registry practices. Not evidence of future or pretrial accuracy. Previous exact-date test has already been inspected; no repeated untouched-test claim.

paired_comparison.method: Paired conditional fitted-model trial bootstrap percentile
paired_comparison.interpretation: Conditional subgroup evidence; excludes fitting/clustering uncertainty and selection optimism. Not chronological/prospective validation.

refinement_evidence.activation: No catalog or project activation performed; requires controller review.

recommendation.rule: Development-only selection; fresh audit was confirmatory under a predeclared gate, never model/threshold tuning.

limitations: This task predicts recorded phase from protocol characteristics; it does not predict progression or trial success.
Combined, NA and unknown phases are excluded. Class support can be small or absent, and classes absent from training have zero predicted probability.

All held-out records count, including labels absent from training. Confusion matrices use the five canonical labels (rows actual, columns predicted); macro-F1 averages the union of actual/predicted labels; balanced accuracy averages recall for actual supported classes.
Validation scores are optimistic after hyperparameter selection; untouched test scores are the held-out estimate. No performance improvement is guaranteed.
Redaction removes explicit phase mentions but cannot eliminate indirect phase cues or post-start updates in current registry snapshots.
Temporal ordering does not establish that current registry labels or protocol features existed at trial start; baseline provenance must be established separately.

Retrospective research phase-consistency model. Current reported enrollment is not planned enrollment. Test schema slot identifies an ID-disjoint partial-start-date subgroup audit, not chronological/prospective validation. Original exact-date test was exposed and is not this branch's test. Class probabilities are uncalibrated; no clinical/regulatory phase assignment or success claim.
Conditional trial bootstrap excludes sponsor/site clustering, fitting uncertainty and development selection optimism.
